summary.result: To examine the improvement of information service efficiency and the applicability, rural amenity resources information and tourist attraction information database were constructed and integrated.
summary.background: Rural amenity resources consist of natural, cultural and social resources.
summary.method: In this paper, we used ontology for semantic integration and introduced the method of external information integration using ontology.
